limitations: Fourteen designed perturbations of two authored fixtures, not 14 independent problems.
Injected axis labels do not measure the distribution of actual predictor errors.
No checkpoint, embedding or frozen development corpus was reconstructed.
Authored expectation checks are neither unseen scoring nor native sandbox qualification.
Valid-but-wrong graphs must remain unchanged; schema repair is not semantic algorithm repair.
Correction/validation time excludes model, embedding, source assembly and native public checking.
Wall-clock limits may stop work earlier on another machine; retain that outcome without retuning.

prediction_descriptor.bindings: input index or 8 + declaration slot; validator enforces lexical scope
prediction_descriptor.structure: preorder first-child/next-sibling tree; all slots predicted in parallel
prediction_descriptor.target: frozen typed IR, no arbitrary expression holes

synthetic_scores.literal_scores: Literal bit values are retained; no bit correction or bit logits.
synthetic_scores.recipe: Every field/slot has score -100 except raw argmax 10. Each injected original value has score 9.
synthetic_scores.warning: Original-token runner-up scores are deliberately favorable synthetic data, not model predictions.
